#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

long mod = 998244353;
vector<vector<long>> cnk(2004, vector<long>(2004, 0));
vector<long> fact(4004, 0);
vector<long> reverse(4004, 0);
vector<long> deg_2(2004, 0);

long bin_pow(long a, long b, long m) {
    long ans = 1;
    while (b != 0) {
        if (b & 1) ans = (ans * a) % m;
        a = (a * a) % m;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    // Precompute binomial coefficients
    cnk[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 2004; i++) {
        cnk[0][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
            cnk[j][i] = (cnk[j - 1][i - 1] + cnk[j][i - 1]) % mod;
        }
    }

    // Precompute factorials
    fact[0] = 1;
    deg_2[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 4004; i++) {
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        deg_2[i] = (deg_2[i - 1] * 2) % mod;
    }

    // Precompute modular inverses of factorials
    reverse[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 3; i < 4004; i += 2) {
        reverse[i] = bin_pow(fact[i], mod - 2, mod);
    }

    int n, k;
    long l;
    cin >> n >> k >> l;
    l %= mod;

    long ans = 0;
    for (int i = k; i <= n; i++) {
        long tmp = 0;
        for (int s = 0, c = 1; s <= n - i; s++, c = -c) {
            long a = 1;
            a = (a * cnk[s][n - i]) % mod;
            a = (a * deg_2[s]) % mod;
            a = (a * fact[s + i]) % mod;
            a = (a * fact[s + i]) % mod;
            a = (a * reverse[2 * (s + i) + 1]) % mod;
            tmp = (tmp + a * c) % mod;
        }
        long b = (tmp * deg_2[i]) % mod;
        b = (b * cnk[i][n]) % mod;
        ans = (ans + b) % mod;
    }

    ans = (ans * l) % mod;
    if (ans < 0) ans += mod;
    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
